news.headline: ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Review: Obefazimod Sustains Week-44 Remission With No Dose-Dependent Malignancy Signal
news.summary: A detailed clinical review of the Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance package put Week-44 clinical remission at roughly 51% for both the 25 mg and 50 mg doses versus about 10% on placebo, with the expanded safety exposure showing no apparent dose-dependent malignancy signal through Week 44.

news.headline: TCG Crossover and Invus Disclose a Combined ~13% Stake in Abivax After the July Offering
news.summary: TCG Crossover disclosed 6,007,834 ADSs (7.0%) and Invus/Avicenna Fund separately disclosed 4,825,759 shares/ADSs (6.0%) around the time of Abivax's $920 million July offering, showing two long-standing biotech specialists held through the raise.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback and aligned with Abivax on the planned submission strategy, content and format of the obefazimod NDA in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. Abivax confirmed it remains on track to file its first-ever NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180 from $132, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its target well above the prevailing share price, citing growing confidence in the obefazimod UC data package and the NDA timeline; it sits at the top of a sell-side range with consensus roughly $148-166.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax hired four senior commercial executives, including a Global Head of Marketing with prior Entyvio and Tezspire launch experience, covering marketing, patient services, sales operations and market access ahead of a potential obefazimod launch.

news.headline: Abivax Reportedly Re-Engages Centerview Amid Renewed Big Pharma Takeover Interest
news.summary: French outlet La Lettre reported that Abivax has re-engaged investment bank Centerview amid renewed acquisition interest from large pharmaceutical companies, though no formal deal has been confirmed.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results and pipeline update
catalysts.detail: Abivax's investor-relations financial calendar confirms half-year 2026 results on September 21, 2026, expected to refresh the post-raise cash position (guided into Q4 2029), R&D spend trajectory, NDA-preparation progress and the U.S. pre-launch commercial build-out.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance data at UEG Week 2026 (Barcelona)
catalysts.detail: Abivax has a pattern of taking full datasets to autumn GI congresses; UEG Week 2026 runs October 17-20 in Barcelona and would be a natural venue for a detailed presentation of the Week-44 maintenance efficacy and safety dataset, though a presentation slot has not been confirmed.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction and 44-week maintenance data and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists Q3 2026 results for December 14, 2026, expected to give an updated read on cash burn, NDA-preparation costs and commercial build-out spend heading into the year-end NDA filing.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe in the second half of 2026, contingent on the (now positive) 44-week maintenance data; recent communication has emphasized the Q4 2026 FDA filing without restating a precise EMA date.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027, opening a second large indication for the miR-124 mechanism.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision on the obefazimod NDA
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, in H2 2027; no PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted.

pulse: Abivax remains squarely in pre-launch mode for obefazimod: the August 19 detailed ABTECT maintenance review found no dose-dependent malignancy signal through Week 44 (~51% remission vs ~10% placebo), reinforcing the positive July 30 pre-NDA FDA meeting that keeps the company on track for a Q4 2026 NDA filing. The $920M July offering funds a solo U.S. commercial build-out, and mid-August 13G filings showed large crossover investors (TCG Crossover, Invus) held their stakes through the raise, while sell-side targets cluster in the $148-180 range (Morgan Stanley at $180) and recurring Big Pharma takeover chatter (Centerview re-engagement) persists. For the March-2027 $120 call, the position stays in-the-money and now hinges on the September 21 H1 results, a possible UEG Week 2026 data presentation, and the Q4 2026 NDA filing landing on schedule.
